implementation.model_stage: bn_model_prepare_native_routers after core+parameters+numerics, same backend owner. implementation.weights: Dedicated immutable native_router_owner buffer; input packed F16[K,N] router gate and raw F32[1,E] bias remain unchanged. One owned allocation holds row-major F16[E,D], signed int8 high/low slices, F32 row scales, centered F16 bias, F32 mean, validation flag and alignment padding. GPU finite-check rejects nonfinite parents/mean and nonfinite centered F16 bias before publication; publication fence. The boundary regression used finite [+70000,-70000] F32 biases: the first version published F16 infinities and selected ID-1; the fixed version rejects setup atomically. First qualification and reproducer logs retained before-center-range-guard/. Free bypasses idle cache; ordinary matvec/matmul reject dedicated handle.
implementation.centering: Torch Reduce.cuh scalar/vector4 mean schedule replicated in default-math TU, with explicit F32 add/sub/mul RN and separate F16 narrowing; original _esb_h AST independently captures (bias-bias.mean()).half(). Every derived byte (including padding/control) compared against original preparation values.
implementation.execution: One row fixed-order FMA half-input/half-output GEMV, then original warp top-k. Multiple rows use original per-row128-element activation quantization, deterministic signed int8 tensor-core GEMM with exact int32 accumulators, fixed F32 split-K re-reduction and F16 logits, then sqrt(softplus) affinities/top-k. No vendor GEMM or per-token projection fallback. K1..32, expert IDs I32 (source I64 selections range-checked and frozen as both I64 and exact I32 values), routing weights F16.
implementation.selection: Mean-centered F16 bias changes selection only; payload remains unbiased affinity. Normalize selected payloads with epsilon1e-20, scale (actual1.5), round F16. Original per-lane/warp tie order preserved; tied expert order can differ from increasing expert ID.
implementation.workspace: Caller-owned exact resident views for F16 x/logits/weights,I32 selections,I8 ahi/alo,F32 activation scales and split partials. bn_gpu_router_workspace computes shape-only split and extents. Empty workspaces required when unused. All views/type/count/alignment/generation/backend owner/overlap checked before work; metadata rejection queues nothing, runtime failures poison request. No execution allocation/copy/fence.
implementation.limits: SM80+ with97KiB opt-in shared memory; E1..512,D128..32768 multiples128,R1..65535,R*D<=INT32_MAX. sqrtsoftplus/no-group/text only; no hash/vision/group routing admitted. Router fast math isolated to new CUDA TU; mean/centering default math. No global mutable library state or GPU handles on CPU model weights.
